name: Yume no Tobira to Yandere o Bukkowasu Button
original_name: 夢の扉とヤンデレをぶっ壊すボタン
source:
The protagonist (you) awakens in the middle of a dream. On the other side of six doors, you become involved with the affairs of six yandere who, for some reason, are surrounded by a gloomy atmosphere.

But this is a dream, so do what you want.

◇ What is the 'Destroy Yandere' button?
Within the choices presented to you is a bizarre-looking button. That's it. If you press it, you'll be able to destroy the yandere.

◇ Any connection to the previous works?
Once again, none in particular, but the world setting is pretty much the same. There won't be any problems even if you haven't played the previous titles, but playing them will likely give you a better understanding of various things.

This story's theme is technically based around April Fool's, but only technically.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9591]the official site[/url]]
translation:
主角（你）在梦中醒来。在六扇门的另一边，你卷入了六个病妇的事务，他们不知为何被阴暗的气氛所包围。

但这是一个梦想，所以做你想做的事吧。

◇ 什么是“摧毁Yandere”按钮？
在呈现给你的选项中有一个看起来很奇怪的按钮。就是这样。如果你按下它，你就能摧毁病娇。

◇ 和之前的作品有什么联系吗？
再说一次，没有什么特别的，但世界背景几乎是一样的。即使你没有玩过以前的游戏也不会有任何问题，但玩它们可能会让你对各种事情有更好的理解。

这个故事的主题在技术上是基于愚人节的，但只是技术上的。

[翻译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/9591]官方网站[/url]]
